q: A glass tube open at both ends and bent into a ____ shape serves as a sensitive device for measuring pressure when filled with coloured water or light oil.
e: Fluid pressure comes from weight. A barometer reads that pressure as the height of a mercury column. A glass tube open at both ends and bent into a U shape serves as a sensitive device for measuring pressure when filled with coloured water or light oil.

q: Such a device is called a ____.
e: Such a device is called a manometer. The name used here is manometer.

q: ____ can also be used as the filling liquid for a manometer.
e: A barometer reads atmospheric pressure. A manometer reads a pressure difference. Mercury can also be used as the filling liquid for a manometer.

q: When both sides of the U-tube are exposed to the atmosphere, the levels of the liquid in the two sides are the ____.
e: When both sides of the U-tube are exposed to the atmosphere, the levels of the liquid in the two sides are the same. Same is what this statement is using.

q: If the pressures on the two liquid columns are different, the levels will no longer be the ____.
e: Fluid pressure comes from weight. A barometer reads that pressure as the height of a mercury column. If the pressures on the two liquid columns are different, the levels will no longer be the same.

q: Manometers are very sensitive for measuring the pressure differences, especially when the filling liquid is water or ____.
e: A barometer reads atmospheric pressure. A manometer reads a pressure difference. Manometers are very sensitive for measuring the pressure differences, especially when the filling liquid is water or light oil.

q: A manometer filled with mercury is ____.
e: A barometer reads atmospheric pressure. A manometer reads a pressure difference. A manometer filled with mercury is not sensitive.

q: A sphygmomanometer which is used to measure ____ is a kind of mercury-filled manometer.
